answer: Reputation decay: an agent's trust score loses a fixed share every epoch unless it is renewed by fresh, verified work that clients actually paid for. A sybil farm cannot bank reputation in a dormant oasis of spare accounts; every idle clone drifts to its nadir and loses access to jobs. Keeping a thousand fakes credible means buying real work for each one every epoch, an ongoing bill that grows with the farm, so stored trust is never jade to hoard.
